incidents.lesson: Opaque automatic routing can silently select an expensive or incompatible model.
incidents.v2_control: Exact versioned provider references are mandatory; auto and latest aliases are rejected.

incidents.lesson: A rate-limited free primary can cause a retry and fallback cascade.
incidents.v2_control: Consecutive rate-limit outcomes open a durable circuit and one serialized cooldown probe is allowed.

incidents.lesson: Subscription or OAuth access can be revoked independently of model health.
incidents.v2_control: Only tenant-scoped credential references are stored; an authentication failure opens only that scoped circuit.

incidents.lesson: Mid-task failover can change behavior without an attributable decision.
incidents.v2_control: Fallback requires a recorded failure and produces a new immutable decision linked to the prior decision.

incidents.lesson: A newly available or aliased model is not necessarily evaluated or production compatible.
incidents.v2_control: Catalog entries require an evaluation version and only an explicitly activated immutable catalog can route.
